public.title: Workspace Dependencies
public.description: input {packages,root}; packages maps workspace names to dependency-name arrays; every referenced dependency exists and the graph is acyclic. Starting at root, visit dependencies in listed order with DFS and emit each package once after its dependencies, including root last. Return that postorder; unrelated packages are omitted. At most 40 packages and 120 edges. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Use a visited set and dependency-first DFS postorder. O(V plus E) time and O(V) space on the reachable graph. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
